### Architectural Overview

**Deterministic ROI Automation Engine** is an enterprise data and API service engineered to quantify exact time and monetary savings generated by software automations, replacing qualitative claims with verified mathematical metrics.

#### Key Architectural Highlights

- **Anti-Hallucination Architecture:** Isolates generative LLMs strictly to schema-bounded entity extraction; all business arithmetic, unit conversions, and monetary valuations are executed in deterministic, test-covered Python domain logic.
- **Verbatim Textual Citations:** Every reported metric is immutably linked to the exact source file, line number, speaker identity, timestamp, and verbatim quote, enabling instant auditability via standard tooling.
- **Dynamic Macroeconomic Valuation:** Real-time integration with Argentine Central Bank (BCRA USD rates) and Ministry of Labor (RIPTE wage series) APIs, calculating dynamic hourly operator, analyst, and manager cost bands with automated stale-cache fallback.
- **Rigorously Tested:** Covered by extensive unit and regression test suites validating mathematical edge cases, plausible cadence bounds, and API resilience under network outages.
